{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the first few rows
top_rows = sales.head()

# Check for internal QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
valid_sales = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Check the distribution of channel and customer_segment
channel_segment = valid_sales[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts().reset_index(name='count')

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = valid_sales.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff_rate = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Return key results
(top_rows, qa_orders.shape[0], valid_sales.shape[0], channel_segment, conversion_rates, diff_rate)"}
